name: Last 10 POS Invoices
query:
SELECT
    a.name AS "Invoice:Link/POS Invoice:160",
    a.posting_date AS "Date:Date:100",
    a.posting_time AS "Time:Time:100",
    a.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:160",
    IFNULL(a.order_type, '') AS "Order Type:Data:110",
    IFNULL(a.restaurant_table, '') AS "Table:Data:100",
    a.grand_total AS "Grand Total:Currency:120",
    a.status AS "Status:Data:110"
FROM
    `tabPOS Invoice` a
WHERE
    a.docstatus = 1
    AND a.branch = %(branch)s
ORDER BY
    a.creation DESC
LIMIT 10
